summary.text: Christine Maltese is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 72, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Scott Krug. A systems analyst and first-time candidate, she says she moved from hospitality into information technology.

paragraphs.text: Christine Maltese graduated from Mother Guerin High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Roosevelt University; Ballotpedia lists her profession as systems analyst.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she began her career in hospitality, working as a pastry chef, before earning her degree and building a career in information technology.
Maltese advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026, with 5,518 votes in an uncontested race.

She described herself in the survey as a first-time candidate and said she is running to strengthen public schools, support working families and small businesses, improve access to affordable healthcare and protect rural communities.
Ballotpedia lists the Wisconsin Education Association Council and the Wisconsin State AFL-CIO among her endorsements.
